# D8 — dumpsys meminfo/gfxinfo returned 'No process found' or empty

**Section**: D. Measurement and transfer
**Keywords**: capturing, cmd_mem, cold-start, dumpsys, empty, force-stopped, found, gfxinfo, launches, loop, measurement, meminfo, preceding, process, render, returned, shizuku, transfer

## Problem

dumpsys meminfo/gfxinfo returned 'No process found' or empty

## Root cause

app process was force-stopped by the preceding cold-start loop

## Solution

launch the app and let it render BEFORE capturing mem/gfx (cmd_mem launches; run gfx after mem)
